analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – the opener is positioned as a premium, durable, and aesthetically pleasing alternative to standard openers. The market for premium, design-focused tools is established, but competition is high.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Weak – lacks concrete evidence of development. Sustainability depends on the longevity of the product and material sourcing.', 'Differentiation': '• Moderate – the spring-loaded mechanism and emphasis on durability offer some differentiation, but many similar designs exist.
